data.narrative:
Stark Defence is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by Florian Seibel, Uwe Horstmann, and Johannes Schaback, having raised over $100M to date. The peer universe comprises 10 comparables across the Defense & Security sector: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Castelion, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing.

Stage-progression valuation was not applicable due to data integrity concerns; the stated post-money valuation of $4.0B implies a multiple exceeding 40x total capital raised, which is inconsistent with typical Series A risk profiles and suggests a potential data parsing error. Peer-median valuation proved the primary triangulation method. Across three same-sector, same-stage comparables—Castelion ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—the median valuation stands at $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $340M to $460M, with a central estimate of $400M. This range reflects the peer-median methodology applied to a limited but representative sample of Series A defense-tech businesses. Key uncertainties include the composition and timing of the peer set, variation in business model and technology maturity across comparables, and macro conditions affecting defense-sector valuations. The tight applicability of a single method underscores the need for additional data on revenue, burn rate, and product differentiation to refine this estimate.
